Presenting KOI BHI DIL MEIN NA AAYA THA FULL VIDEO SONG from LAPARWAH movie starring Mithun Chakraborty, Ranjeeta Kaur, Shakti Kapoor, Iftekhar in lead roles, released in 1981. The song is sung by Kishore Kumar, Chandrani Mukherjee and music is given by Bappi Lahiri, music is available exclusively on Gaane Sune Ansune.
Song: KOI BHI DIL MEIN NA AAYA THA
Singer: KISHORE KUMAR, CHANDRANI MUKHERJEE
Music Director: BAPPI LAHIRI
Lyricist: RAMESH PANT
